Properties.commandText:
CREATE TABLE [Categories] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [NameAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [DescriptionAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [DescriptionAEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Iconpath] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Status] int NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Categories] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [Lk_DiscountMethods] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [NameAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Lk_DiscountMethods] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [Lk_DiscountTypes] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [NameAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Lk_DiscountTypes] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [ServiceProviders] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [TitelAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [TitleEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [DescriptionAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [DescriptionAEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Location] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Email] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Website] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Mobile] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Number] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Image] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Status] int NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_ServiceProviders] PRIMARY KEY ([Id])
);

CREATE TABLE [SubCategories] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [NameAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Status] int NOT NULL,
    [CategoryId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_SubCategories] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_SubCategories_Categories_CategoryId] FOREIGN KEY ([CategoryId]) REFERENCES [Categories] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE [ServiceProviderImages] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [ServiceProviderId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [ImagePath] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [ImageName] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_ServiceProviderImages] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_ServiceProviderImages_ServiceProviders_ServiceProviderId] FOREIGN KEY ([ServiceProviderId]) REFERENCES [ServiceProviders] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE [ServiceProviderLikes] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [ServiceProviderId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [UserId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_ServiceProviderLikes] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_ServiceProviderLikes_ServiceProviders_ServiceProviderId] FOREIGN KEY ([ServiceProviderId]) REFERENCES [ServiceProviders] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE [Offers] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [NameAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [NameEN] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [DescriptionAr] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [DescriptionAEn] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Lk_DiscountTypeId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [Lk_DiscountMethodId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [DiscountLink] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [DiscountAmount] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Conditions] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [SubCategoryId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CategoryId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [StartDate] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [StartTime] time NOT NULL,
    [EndDate] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [EndTime] time NOT NULL,
    [ImagePth] nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
    [Status] int NOT NULL,
    [ServiceProviderId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    [CreatedBy] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [CreatedOn] datetime2 NOT NULL,
    [UpdatedBy] uniqueidentifier NULL,
    [UpdatedOn] datetime2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_Offers] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Offers_Categories_CategoryId] FOREIGN KEY ([CategoryId]) REFERENCES [Categories] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Offers_Lk_DiscountMethods_Lk_DiscountMethodId] FOREIGN KEY ([Lk_DiscountMethodId]) REFERENCES [Lk_DiscountMethods] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Offers_Lk_DiscountTypes_Lk_DiscountTypeId] FOREIGN KEY ([Lk_DiscountTypeId]) REFERENCES [Lk_DiscountTypes] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Offers_ServiceProviders_ServiceProviderId] FOREIGN KEY ([ServiceProviderId]) REFERENCES [ServiceProviders] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT [FK_Offers_SubCategories_SubCategoryId] FOREIGN KEY ([SubCategoryId]) REFERENCES [SubCategories] ([Id]) ON DELETE NO ACTION
);

CREATE TABLE [OfferLikeUseds] (
    [Id] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [OfferId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [UserId] uniqueidentifier NOT NULL,
    [OfferType] int NOT NULL,
    [State] int NOT NULL,
    [RowVersion] rowversion NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT [PK_OfferLikeUseds] PRIMARY KEY ([Id]),
    CONSTRAINT [FK_OfferLikeUseds_Offers_OfferId] FOREIGN KEY ([OfferId]) REFERENCES [Offers] ([Id]) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
